name: COPOD
tagline: Copula-Based Outlier Detection: per-feature empirical CDF tail probabilities aggregated as joint anomaly scores under a copula model.
diff_from_baseline: Li et al. 2020 (COPOD, ICDM). Parameter-free copula-based detector that combines marginal tail probabilities; very fast and surprisingly competitive on tabular benchmarks (PyOD default wrapper).

name: ECOD
tagline: Empirical-CDF Outlier Detection: per-dimension tail probabilities aggregated into a single anomaly score, no hyperparameters.
diff_from_baseline: Li et al. 2022 (ECOD, IEEE TKDE). Parameter-free per-dimension empirical CDF tail detector, faster than COPOD and a strong default on tabular ADBench tasks.

name: Isolation Forest
tagline: Random isolation trees: anomalies require fewer random splits to isolate, so shorter expected path length implies higher anomaly score.
diff_from_baseline: Liu et al. 2008 (Isolation Forest, ICDM). The canonical tree-isolation anomaly detector. Used here via PyOD's IForest with scikit-learn backend and seed-controlled randomness.

name: LOF
tagline: Local Outlier Factor: density-based score comparing each point's reachability density to that of its k-nearest neighbors.
diff_from_baseline: Breunig et al. 2000 (LOF, SIGMOD). Density-based local outlier detector. Run here with PyOD defaults plus MinMax scaling to match the ADBench Table D4 protocol.

name: OCSVM
tagline: One-Class SVM: learns a kernel-induced boundary around normal data; points outside the boundary are scored as anomalies.

key_hyperparams.name: nu
key_hyperparams.role: upper bound on outlier fraction / margin slack

diff_from_baseline: Schölkopf et al. 2001 (Neural Computation). One-Class SVM for high-dimensional support estimation. Run with PyOD defaults plus MinMax scaling to match the ADBench protocol.
